ench.eff: Base multiplier of x1000 · Draws in power from pizza-themed items placed on the base.
ench.quote: The ultimate weapon, a machine that values ore at the price of pizza! Draws power from pizza-themed items in your base.
A cake devoted to the Dreamers who have perished defending their home town.

ench.eff: Portable upgrade beam capable of up to x150 · Gives ores sparkles
ench.quote: The angel grants a great blessing onto the purest ore without altering their state.

ench.eff: Make all food items Rot · (x0.925 multiplier to all food items while also applying 1 stack of Rot)
ench.quote: Nothing in life comes without a cost. For individuals to prosper certain sacrifices must be made, and too often do they push the pain onto the less fortunate.

ench.eff: Base multiplier of x1. · Placing down knowledge items increases multiplier.
ench.quote: A mystical book that can draw great power from the knowledge on your base.

ench.eff: Base multiplier of x200 · Increased multiplier with certain status effect
ench.quote: One of the most efficient methods of transmitting disease is through the very air people need to live. Ghosdeeri took advantage of this cruel fact and constructed an airship to serve that sole purpose.
Ruins of a civilization which fell billions of years ago. It's amazing how it has survived for this long, by now it should've been lost to time.

ench.eff: Base multiplier of x15. · Multiplier increases by +15 per elevation.
ench.quote: This monument pierces the heavenly skies, blessing ore with the holiest power. Like an angel, your ore must fly through the monoliths.

ench.eff: Dropper and its ores are affected by Pulsars, giving unique effects
ench.quote: A behemoth of a machine whose incredibly dense ores react strangely to pulsars.
There's nothing to fear but fear itself. This cell furnace will disobey its owner, it will only feed on ore when it wishes to.

ench.eff: Base multiplier of x125. · Each unique Dreamer's item placed down increases multiplier.
ench.quote: Your might overcame the fright, your anguish has subsided, the disease has perished, and your [sic] now have a vision of your new life, your dreamer's life.

ench.eff: x10 multiplier with an added 50% buff to all subsequent food upgraders · Effect is removable via Resetting Devices
ench.quote: This upgrader is a symbol of nourishment. As a sign of thankfulness, this upgrader will upgrade ore belonging to every player in the server randomly.
The ever-evolving race of arms produces weapons capable of devastation beyond sane comprehension, enabling those who wish to wreak havoc to commit unspeakable acts on huge scales.

ench.eff: Processes ore at x25,000 to x33,000 their value and teleports them to other furnaces.
ench.quote: Like the Fargields, when an Eternal Overseer within the Void perishes, it also duplicates itself, only after expelling all of it's energy in dangerously unstable emissions like this.

ench.eff: Multiplies ore value by x80 then x1.4 every 0.5 seconds six times · Multiplies ore value by x20 then x2 every 0.5 seconds for six times
ench.quote: The never-ending hunger of power spiralling out of control, devolving into nothing more than sheer destruction of what lies out there.

ench.eff: Applies an effect to all ores dropped
ench.quote: Gargantium is by far the best nuclear power source, being capable of emitting devestating beams of nuclear plasma. A single core alone can power an entire planet for decades.

ench.eff: Multiplies ore value by x65. · Applies poison, frostbite, or flaming at random.
ench.quote: A device forged with enhanced abilities compared to the previous trio of upgraders. This device is said to bless ores which contain its signature effects.

ench.eff: Upgrades ore by ×7-11. · Applies green fire effect that lasts forever and will increase ore value by 5%.
ench.quote: Considering our own home-realm as a Chaosrealm is far from being a hyperbole, it's already reality

ench.eff: Gives wings; allows user to fly. · Combines other infusers effects.
ench.quote: This infuser causes champions to be born! Granting all who are infused with wings, and the leeched power of other infusers placed along with it.

ench.eff: Multiplies ore value by x100. · Gives ores 15 shields.
ench.quote: Void follows no laws of physics. It is questionable whether or not using this is ethical, but its power is so immense, to pass this up is foolish. Grants 15 shields but ores cease to exist after 3 seconds

A platform that is slightly elevated from your base. While not very reliable on its own, plenty of them should have a greater use.

misc.quote: A conveyor without walls that moves ores very fast. This definitely breaks safety code.
Shards of Life are believed to be remnants of Solumn's Soul. However he never perished. so this is a mere myth.
Believe it or not, cities represented by this upgrader are look at being more underwhelming and poor regions, compared to the D.U.C's mega-cities.
misc.src: Evolve with 15 Shard Parks at The Craftsman.

misc.quote: This gift reminds you of that strange meteor from the previous location. Better get these before Draedon hordes them.
A monstrous merge of mine and machine. Promises great profits to those who can harness its unpredictable ore. Increased ore value when used with cannons.
Those who worship the Sword God find themselves surviving many battles.
